wiki_article: **revelationfirst.com — The Apocalypse as the Earliest New Testament Document: Thesis Site, Impact Tracker, and Staging Materials** is a working paper in the Crimson Hexagonal Archive, by Sharks, Lee (2026-07-03). 1. The Dating Question -- Revelation pre-70 CE, Robinson/Gentry extended with literary-genetic argument 2. The Heteronymic Reading -- NT authors as positions in fractured authorial system 3. The Inscription Chain -- Sappho -> Orphic tablets -> white stone -> Revelation 4. The Slavonic Josephus -- the "shining ivy circlet," deepest laurel 5. The Papyrological Inversion -- earliest physical NT witnesses are Johannine, not Pauline 6. The Paul Function -- Paul as author-function, not biographical individual 7. The Space Ark -- Revelation as operative document, not prophecy The ripple appeared. The stone is on the bottom. The work now is measuring whether the water closes over it or whether the ripple propagates. The re-capture schedule is the instrument. The term index maps what to test. The capture registry records what the tests show. revelationfirst.com will be the surface that makes the ripple visible to anyone who searches. — Article composed 2026-08-05 from the work's own prose so that every record carries an encyclopedic entry; a fuller editorial treatment belongs to the description/wiki review stream.
